name: Linked Helper
description: Linked Helper is a desktop LinkedIn automation product for prospect collection, outreach campaigns, messaging sequences, profile extraction, enrichment, CRM delivery, and team workspaces.
agentUseSummary: Linked Helper documents a desktop browser that does not use LinkedIn's API and supports outbound webhooks configured inside campaign workflows, but it does not publish a supported third-party API for controlling the app or reading a customer's workspace. Relay therefore does not capture LinkedIn or Linked Helper login credentials, automate the desktop app, ingest prospect webhooks, or expose agent actions.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action is offered until Linked Helper publishes a supported, contract-compatible third-party control or read API.

runtimeSupport.description: No contract-compatible bounded Relay connector is available.
No contract-compatible bounded Relay connector is available.

providerSetup.blocker: Linked Helper does not publish a third-party API for controlling its desktop browser or reading a customer workspace; its documented integration is outbound campaign webhook/CRM delivery containing prospect and messaging data.
providerSetup.nextAction: Reassess only if Linked Helper publishes a stable third-party API with explicit authentication, permissions, schemas, distribution terms, revocation, and bounded non-LinkedIn-automation reads suitable for Relay.

evidence.supports: Official product material describes a desktop app for LinkedIn outreach, profile extraction, enrichment, CRM/webhook export, local or cloud storage, licenses, credits, and campaign automation.
Official support states Linked Helper does not use LinkedIn's API and instead runs on the user's computer as a browser imitating user actions.
Official support documents only an outbound campaign action that posts selected prospect and optional messaging fields to a configured webhook; it is not a third-party app-control API.
Linked Helper's own support acknowledges that use can conflict with LinkedIn rules, reinforcing the decision not to automate the app or LinkedIn through Relay.
Official terms identify Linked Helper as unaffiliated with LinkedIn and do not publish a Relay-compatible developer authorization or API distribution contract.
